scope: Authored fictional teaching fixtures, not app logs, fitted probabilities or measurements of the Week 4 bios. Each case below is a separate scenario; do not join their rows.

pairTable.unit: One of 100 eligible fictional pairs, with both selection decisions supplied, even if the first is no. All decisions refer to one complete invented 24-hour window.

repeated.scope: A separate probability model of new eligible pair opportunities, not sampling the 100 table rows without replacement.

venueScope: Invented Friday routes and prices. Each travel leg includes bus, walking and waiting; transportCents covers both legs. Meeting and all travel must fit 17:00–19:00; costs are Alex's total. These are options, not new biography or real venue advice.
windowUnit: One distinct eligible fictional pair offered both selection directions, with a complete 24-hour outcome window. At most one mutual match per pair. Separate disjoint pools; time was not randomly assigned.
